dialogues.speaker: Scribbled Treasure Hoarder Notes
dialogues.text: "The thing Boss wanted us to find should be at the top, but how do we get up there?"

dialogues.speaker: Scribbled Treasure Hoarder Notes
dialogues.text: "A pal said there is probably treasure in here. I can see a mechanism, but... how do we get the treasure?"

dialogues.speaker: Scribbled Treasure Hoarder Notes
dialogues.text: "Perhaps we have to run to the top in a certain amount of time in order to get the treasure... haha!"

dialogues.speaker: Scribbled Treasure Hoarder Notes
dialogues.text: "Anyways, let's find what Boss wants fast and get outta here."

dialogues.speaker: Scribbled Treasure Hoarder Notes
dialogues.text: "I have a strange feeling that someone is watching me..."
